content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents and read_document to locate and read candidate_specs.md and any ageing/transparency or radiator performance documents. Extract the three allowed radiator candidates, any documented humidity ageing transparency losses, and permitted/recommended thickness ranges."},{"id":"s2","description":"Eliminate any radiator candidate whose documented 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing transparency loss exceeds 10%, or whose usable thickness cannot satisfy the 1–6 cm constraint. Record the transparency loss values numerically where available."},{"id":"s3","description":"For each remaining candidate, run simulate_separation at a coarse grid of thicknesses from 1 to 6 cm, such as 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 cm. Record each simulated pion/kaon separation value."},{"id":"s4","description":"Identify the candidate/thickness regions that meet the hard 3.5 sigma separation requirement and have the highest simulated separation. If the best point is not clearly at a grid boundary, run additional simulate_separation scans around the best thickness region with finer spacing to find the optimal thickness."},{"id":"s5","description":"Select the single radiator and thickness with the best pion/kaon separation among options satisfying all hard constraints: candidate listed in candidate_specs.md, thickness 1–6 cm, transparency loss after ageing not above 10%, and separation at least 3.5 sigma. Record the final chosen thickness and separation numerically for the reporting module."}]}
